title: The Philistine raiding parties and Israel's lack of weapons
description: From the Philistine camp, raiding parties went out in three detachments that spread toward Ophrah, Beth-Horon and the Valley of Zeboim. There was no blacksmith to be found in all Israel, for the Philistines had forbidden the Hebrews to make swords or spears. The Israelites had to go down to the Philistines to have their plowshares, mattocks, axes and sickles sharpened, and they paid for the work. On the day of battle, none in Saul's army had a sword or spear—only Saul and Jonathan were armed.
